Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the ML Engineer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the required experience in key areas: ML in production, modern deep learning techniques, excellent Python skills, proficiency with ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LightGBM, Scikit-learn), microservices and cloud technologies, and practical experience with tabular and time series data.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
